Local CAS is not atomic with external native policy edits.

Collect complete event pages + required task graph
Native facts, nullable fields, task links

Freeze cohort coverage and generation G
Publish canonical G + pinned manifest/coverage — await ACK
Read back generation / canonical IDs / semantic digest

Every candidate, own allowance, count, source witness
Facts + pinned manifest reference + evidence limits
Actual context-read / issue / native session evidence
Apply reviewed native policy through UI / verified CLI
